searchText: Last chance to review https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/230 and https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/235 I'll probably be merging those in the next day as they seem to be settled and ready to go... #230 I'm not a massive fan of the use of "will" in the text. If this is a specification they should be "must" (if I'm reading the spec correctly). yep thats fair, did you want me to copy that to PR or you happy to comment? just for context im now a maintainer and sweeping low hanging fruit 🙂 will try to get a few more maintainers too.... have some ideas of who to volunteer 🙂 it seems like we need to run a build before we use swagger, as long as that's fair, can probably add it to the readme to remove confusion (maybe mostly mine? not sure) Go for it. Both PRs look good to me I'd like to offer up https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/242 for final approval & merge 🙏
